text.en: Codex Subscription reports interrupted image responses with the network error, HTTP status and request ID when available.
text.zh-CN: Codex 订阅在生图响应中断时显示可用的网络错误、HTTP 状态和请求编号。

text.en: The Git dialog shows changed files and the commit form side by side on wider windows. File status badges and a selection count make changes easier to scan, and the commit actions stay visible while scrolling.
text.zh-CN: Git 弹窗在宽屏并排显示改动与提交表单，用状态标记和已选数量帮助浏览文件，滚动时仍可看到提交操作。

text.en: Visual Curator accepts images from multiple local folders and their subfolders. Add more images or folders in the import dialog, then save to queue large selections as numbered batches.
text.zh-CN: 视觉策展支持选择多个本地文件夹及其子文件夹，并可在导入弹窗继续追加。确认保存后，大量原图会分批排队处理。

text.en: Visual Curator measures attached foliage, tails, bumpers and table bases during wallpaper review. Rework checks whether the original framing fits the safe area, and reviewing a saved candidate uses the selected image.
text.zh-CN: 视觉策展在壁纸复审时核对相连枝叶、尾梢、保险杠和边几底座。返工前检查原图取景与安全区能否同时满足，点选已保存的候选会复审该张图片。
